{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = '999999.99')
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df_completed[~qa_mask]

# Convert revenue to float (though not used for conversion rate)
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute difference: email - paid_search
diff = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Conversion rate for email: {conversion_rates['email']}")
print(f"Conversion rate for paid_search: {conversion_rates['paid_search']}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {diff}")"}
